local_source_note: Working source snapshot. Large upstream image assets, Git history and CUDA submodule sources are kept on server; clone the pinned upstream commit to reproduce locally.
protocol: Ex4DGS baseline -> frozen train residual candidates -> matched Ex4DGS and shared-geometry RT continuations -> validation selects entire final model -> test after decision
data: coffee_martini frame 0; original 15 training cameras unchanged; cam00/cam09 validation; cam19 final test; original train-only 5620-point COLMAP initialization. Earlier baseline previews already showed all three held-out cameras.
baseline: Official Ex4DGS model/rasterizer/training losses, approved-data loader and passive observer added. Single-frame run disables dynamic extraction and motion regularizers, uses original world units with near=0.01; official N3DV paper settings are not claimed.
detection: 32px patches, MSE > max(2 * same-image global MSE, 0.0001), high in >=80% of 5 observations, <=10% improvement, final observation high; late observations at 26k/27k/28k/29k/30k
selection: Positive-only train candidates. Validation ROIs from baseline validation residuals frozen before optimization, hashed, evaluation-only. Per-camera components are not physical cross-view glass identities.
optics: Same existing Ex4DGS Gaussian collection. Ex 3D volume transmission with occupancy*optical-opacity; official RT 2D deferred surface rasterizer with9 extra channels. SphMip9levels512x1024x16, features4, MLP80->256->256->4. Official roughness sampling, reflected rays, attenuation, transmission/scatter/specular composition and specular-aware gradient gating.
limitations: Current runner validates frame0 only and rejects dynamic/multiframe baselines; renderer time-dependent geometry support is not evidence of full dynamic quality.
High residuals can be non-glass. No glass or glass-depth ground truth; photometric decomposition is ambiguous.
Fixed topology can limit recovery of a missing surface.
Equal iterations are not equal runtime or parameter count. Selection thresholds are engineering choices, not statistical significance tests.
evaluation: Last3 observations, >=2 passes AND final pass. Pooled candidate gain>=0.5dB; each eligible view>=0; mean full-image PSNR gain>=0; outside MSE increase<=2% pooled AND per-view. >=2 validation views with>=128 candidate pixels each. Else select additional-trained Ex4DGS. Whole-model fallback, no image splicing. Test only after saving selection.
legacy: Independent-plane run_surface_hypotheses.py and related deployment scripts are historical only. Production coffee config dispatches run_rt_ex4dgs.py.
environment: Python3.10 Torch2.1.2+cu118 CUDA11.8 gcc11. Official RT renderer built against same Ex environment. nvdiffrast0.4.0 pinned253ac4fcea7de5f396371124af597e6cc957bfae.
necessary_adaptations: Hybrid3D volume/2D surface differs from original all-2D RT. Same centers/scales/rotations, no separate planes or assumed glass depths.
Surfel normal uses each ellipsoid initially shortest axis, fixed axis permutation, differentiable learned rotations and centers.
Restored Ex RAdam state for geometry/color/occupancy; official RT Adam rates for new material and lighting parameters.
Both continuation branches keep completed-baseline topology fixed; original RT densification not ported.
Mask BCE averaged over selected positives only, no opaque/zero-transmissivity supervision outside, empty selections safely skipped.
Original consistency spatial SUM retained; disconnected candidates in one image share the original global mean.
MLP chunking and activation recomputation preserve equations while reducing memory.
Nonzero volume distortion rejected because Ex rasterizer lacks the statistic; original default zero.
Official surface near clipping0.2 vs Ex volume0.01; actual affected-center counts saved in protocol.
schedule: 5000 additional steps each, same checkpoint and optimizer state, camera order and random backgrounds. RT loss clock starts at additional step1; official LPIPS from15000 stays inactive in this5000-step trial. Official alpha/transmissivity initialization0.5. Evaluation/previews every1000.
mask_scope: All existing Gaussians have RT materials; candidates supervise positives, not a hard pixel RT switch. Outside still receives photometric loss, no glass/opaque labels.
checkpoint: latest.pth stores both models/optimizers, complete RT materials+encoding+MLP/optimizer, RNG/sampler queue and protocol. selected.pth standalone rendering via render_rt_selected.py. Resume validates frozen masks and config.
